Cabinet supply only, owner installation

Supply cabinets only for a kitchen in Boise, Idaho: exactly 12 LF base cabinets, 8 LF wall cabinets and zero tall cabinets. Mid-range painted shaker, plywood boxes, soft-close hinges and drawer slides. Standard widths, no custom millwork, no island. Owner will collect and install all cabinets and provide installation supplies. Exclude delivery, installation labor, demolition, countertops, sink, plumbing, electrical, flooring, appliances, design and permits. No other work requested.
